name: Vicious Cleave (Combat)
body:
You know how to make your attacks of opportunities lethal.

Prerequisite: Str 13, Cleave, Power Attack, Vital Strike, base attack bonus +6

Benefit: You may use Vital Strike, Improved Vital Strike, or Greater Vital Strike whenever you cleave.
